title: Supply the correct form of the word given in each sentence.
description: Read the sentence and provide the correct form of the word in brackets.

questions.text: Many eco-friendly supermarkets avoid using __________ plastic wrap for fresh vegetables.
Proper waste sorting increases the proportion of __________ materials sent to recovery plants.
The rapid __________ of discarded vegetable peelings produces nutrient-rich garden compost.
Installing rooftop solar panels helps families power their homes __________.
Tossing oily cardboard into the paper collection causes serious __________ of clean materials.
